literal.prompt: Какое важное изменение произошло в России в 1861 году?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library article says that Alexander II signed the Manifesto on the Abolition of Serfdom on 19 February (3 March) 1861 (L51), which directly identifies the unique keyed change. The notes supply exact later/earlier dates for the distractors: the Kremlin is first mentioned in 1147 (UNESCO L46-L48), the Soviet Union’s dissolution agreement is from 1991 (Presidential Library L44-L50), and Russia’s WWI participation is in 1914 (Presidential Library PDF P18 L395-L396). The four answer statements are all historical events/changes, but only the keyed one belongs to 1861.
literalGroups.locator: PRlib Alexander II L51; UNESCO L46-L48; PRlib Belovezha L44-L50; PRlib Nicholas II PDF P18 L395-L396

literalGroups.literal: В 1861 году Александр II подписал Манифест об отмене крепостного права. Помещичьи крестьяне получили личную свободу.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library passage explicitly states that Alexander II signed the 1861 Manifesto abolishing serfdom among landlord peasants; it supports both sentences without relying on an unsupported population count.

literalGroups.literal: Кремль впервые упомянут в Ипатьевской летописи в 1147 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO identifies the Kremlin as the oldest part of Moscow and states that it is first mentioned in the Hypatian Chronicle in 1147; the revised note accurately names the Kremlin rather than conflating it with the whole city.

literalGroups.literal: Беловежское соглашение 1991 года положило конец существованию СССР.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library says the Belovezha Agreement was signed on 8 December 1991 to terminate the USSR and create the CIS; the note is a concrete date-and-outcome fact about the USSR.

literalGroups.literal: В 1861 году император Александр II отменил крепостное право.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library states that Alexander II signed the Manifesto abolishing serfdom on 19 February (3 March) 1861; naming the ruler is an additional fact beyond the prompt’s year and answer’s event.

literalGroups.literal: В 1914 году Россия участвовала в Первой мировой войне из-за вступления в Антанту.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library’s retained exhibition says that in 1914 Russia could not avoid participation in the First World War because it joined the Entente; the note follows that bounded statement.
literalGroups.locator: PRlib Nicholas II PDF P18 L395-L396
